summary: Demis Hassabis announced the launch of SL2T, a sign-language-to-text model allowing users to sign directly to their phones, developed in collaboration with the Deaf community.

practices.reason: A new model interprets sign language input on-device, a new modality capability, though no performance figures or benchmarks are given.
practices.quote: SL2T is our amazing sign-language-to-text model allows users to sign directly to their phones for the first time.
